article_content: Matt Chorley, Mailonline Political Editor, unveils Vince Cable's political 'Foxtrot' amidst rumors of pivoting to Labour's Ed Miliband, on the side of Conservative Prime Minister David Cameron. Sir Menzies Campbell cautions against dance partners change, while Vince Cable introduces new employment laws purportedly favorable to small businesses. The BBC Andrew Marr Show witnessed an unexpected dance between Vince and Labour's Ed Balls, which Tony Chuka perceives as a flirtation beyond the stage. The TUC decries the new low caps on unfair dismissal settlements.
